{{nihongo|'''Tokari Shrine'''|利雁神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Kawachi Province]].

'''Tokari Shrine''' (とかりじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Shakudo, {{ill|Habikino|Q694308|qid=Q694308}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}. In the Meiji period it was {{ill|Shrine Consolidation Policy|Q11590700|qid=Q11590700|lt=merged}} into {{ill|Migukurumitama Shrine|Q11608777|qid=Q11608777}} in Miya-chō, {{ill|Tondabayashi|Q490928|qid=Q490928}}, becoming a {{ill|Sessha|Q135009904|qid=Q135009904}} of that shrine, but a shrine of the same name was later rebuilt at the old site in Shakudo.

=== Enshrined deities ===
It enshrines {{ill|Ukemochi|Q2280323|qid=Q2280323}}, {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997|lt=Homudawake-no-Mikoto}}, and {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|fr|Ama-no-Koyane-no-mikoto|it|Ame-no-Koyane|ja|天児屋命|mni|ꯑꯃꯦ-ꯅꯣ-ꯀꯣꯌꯅꯦ|pt|Ame-no-Koyane|ru|Амэ-но коянэ-но микото|simple|Ame-no-Koyane|zh|天兒屋命|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}.

''Dai Nihon Shi Jingi-shi'' and ''Chiri Shiryo'' state that it enshrines the ancestral deity of the Yora clan, descendants of {{ill|Nigihayahi|fr|Nigihayahi|ja|ニギハヤヒ|simple|Nigihayahi|zh|饒速日命|qid=Q10949054|lt=Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}}. ''Jinja Yōroku'' lists "deity unknown."

=== History ===
The shrine's founding history is unknown. It originally stood on Mount Tokari in the southwest of Shakudo village and was also called "Ō no Miya." In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} it is listed as a minor shrine. The shrine buildings were lost in warfare in the Tenshō era, and it was relocated in Keichō 17. In {{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}} (Meiji 5), it was ranked as a village shrine, but on October 12, Meiji 40, it was merged into Migukurumitama Shrine in Aza Miya, {{ill|Kishi|Q18700084|qid=Q18700084}} (present-day Miya-chō, Tondabayashi).

The time of rebuilding is unknown, but after the merger Tokari Shrine was rebuilt west of Saifuku-ji in Shakudo, Habikino.
